name: Palitha Godellawatta
description: Lakguardian was founded under the visionary leadership of Major General (Retired) Palitha Godellawatta, a highly respected and accomplished military officer with a remarkable career dedicated to national security, strategic leadership, and operational excellence.

With decades of distinguished service in the Sri Lanka Army, Maj Gen (Rtd) Godellawatta has held key command and leadership positions that demanded precision, discipline, and decisive decision-making in high-pressure environments. His vast experience in crisis management, risk assessment, and security strategy has shaped his deep understanding of modern security challenges.

Motivated by a strong commitment to public safety and ethical service, he established Lakguardian to bring elite military standards of discipline, professionalism, and reliability into the private security sector. His vision is to build a security organization that goes beyond protection one that earns trust, inspires confidence, and delivers peace of mind to every client.
Under his guidance, Lakguardian upholds the highest principles of integrity, accountability, and dedication, ensuring the safety and security of people, property, and businesses across Sri Lanka.
